verdict.rationale: Gemini's own documentation describes creating custom Gems by providing information about your request and requirements, which covers building a custom assistant with its own instructions. The pack never shows Gems carrying attached knowledge files or being shared with others; the knowledge-retaining Notebooks feature is a separate feature and earns no credit here. missing for 10: evidence of attaching knowledge/files to a Gem, evidence of sharing Gems with others, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can build and share custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge

citations.quote: To create a custom Gem to meet your goals, provide info about your request and requirements.
